    Inbound Address

    Inbound Address

    Publish this gateway on your own domain, with your edge certificate and mutual TLS.

    The platform host stays published

    acme-insurance.sensedia.com keeps answering on the Sensedia wildcard certificate. The host below is published in addition to it, not in place of it.

    Point this host’s DNS to the load balancer provisioned for your tenant. Enter it without http:// or https:// and without a path.
    Certificates are registered in Virtual Hosts › Certificates.

    Consumers must present a client certificate signed by one of the selected trust stores.

    mTLS applies to every HTTPS listener on this gateway

    acme-insurance.sensedia.com starts rejecting consumers that do not present a client certificate signed by one of the selected trust stores.

    A client certificate signed by any of the selected trust stores is accepted. Trust stores are registered in Virtual Hosts › Trust Stores.
